<thought>To locate the appropriate retrosynthetic template, I will query the template catalog for any templates that are applicable to the target molecule (the Diels‑Alder adduct). By omitting additional filtering criteria and requesting a modest number of results, the service will return templates that can be applied to the molecule. One of these should correspond to the Diels‑Alder retro‑transformation. I will then examine the returned templates and select the one whose mapped reaction SMILES shows a [4+2] cycloaddition (i.e., a six‑membered ring being split into a diene and a dienophile).</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O",
    "limit": 20
}</action_input>
